name: workbench
description: Five explicit Workbench skills for evidence-backed shaping, canonical Dev Wiki Shape and Prepare artifacts, task-scoped standard Git worktree execution, and integrated validation.

interface.shortDescription: Shape, persist, prepare, and execute isolated tasks.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides five independently invoked skills: shape a change from repository, Local Work Memory, linked Jira and Figma artifacts, and official evidence; persist canonical Shape or Prepare artifacts to Dev Wiki; prepare an exact task DAG without creating worktrees; create one standard Git worktree per implementation or integration task; and finalize the clean integrated result with failure testing and independent review.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to create a sourced Shape Report for this change.
Use $workbench:prepare to turn a persisted Shape artifact into task worktree packets.
Use $workbench:execute-task to create and execute one persisted task worktree.
